first_party_annotation.label: Ray Sang’s Annotation
first_party_annotation.scope: New first-party editorial gap descriptions and source-review notes only, to the extent rights exist and are controlled. Excludes facts, titles, publisher/government text, existing licenses and statutory/platform rights.

claims.claim: For an expenditure-driven nonexchange award, incurring allowable costs is an eligibility condition; receiving cash is a separate event.
claims.boundary: Restrict to stipulated nonexchange award and other eligibility already met.

claims.claim: A permitted-use period and a required purpose ask different questions: purpose restrictions alone do not postpone recognition.
claims.boundary: No inference about the legality or satisfaction of an actual grant clause.

claims.claim: Governmental-fund recognition also requires revenue availability; a state’s local availability convention is not a universal deadline.
claims.exact_locator: Revenue Recognition Using the Modified Accrual Basis of Accounting
claims.boundary: Future example supplies its own justified availability assumption.

claims.claim: Unused leave analysis considers service already performed, accumulation and expected use or settlement; used leave awaiting payment is separately recognized.
claims.exact_locator: Opening recognition criteria; Comptroller’s Office Methodology for the Liability Calculation
claims.boundary: Qualifying annual leave only; no quantitative probability threshold claimed.

claims.claim: Measurement uses reporting-date compensation and applicable incremental salary-related amounts; defined-benefit pension/OPEB salary-related payments are excluded from that leave measure.
claims.exact_locator: Salary-Related Payments; Comptroller’s Office Methodology for the Liability Calculation
claims.boundary: Example rates and expected qualifying hours must be explicit assumptions.

claims.claim: Governmental-fund expenditure recognition and economic-resources liability recognition require separate analyses.
claims.boundary: Do not turn a current/noncurrent split into a governmental-fund recognition rule.

claims.claim: Later salary or tax-rate changes affect the current period’s salary-related liability measurement.
claims.boundary: No automatic universal tax percentage; apply supported facts.

claims.claim: A fully depreciated asset removed without proceeds requires removing gross asset cost and its accumulated depreciation.
claims.boundary: Narrow Texas disposal route; local label is not universal.

claims.claim: A governmental-fund sale is presented as a financing source; accrual conversion also removes asset/depreciation balances and recognizes the gain or loss.
claims.exact_locator: Governmental Funds > Modified to Full Accrual Adjustments for Capital Assets; Governmental Activities – Basis Conversion (Fund Type 11)
claims.boundary: Assume no sale costs and provide original arithmetic rather than reproducing state examples.

claims.claim: A qualifying donated capital asset is measured at acquisition value; after receipt and satisfaction of eligibility, the government-wide entry recognizes asset and revenue.
claims.boundary: Assume operational use and capitalization criteria; no fair-value substitution.

claims.claim: A revision arising from new information or changed circumstances is handled prospectively; a changed measurement method needs support for why it is preferable.
claims.boundary: Not a rule permitting correction of known mistakes through current expense.

claims.claim: Significant estimate changes require an explanation identifying their nature and affected financial-statement lines.
claims.boundary: No claim that every small input revision needs a standalone note.

claims.claim: A mistake or misuse of facts available when prior statements were issued can be an error rather than a new estimate.
claims.boundary: Evidence timeline must distinguish what was knowable then from what emerged later.

claims.claim: The basic-statement correction model restates affected prior periods; effects before the earliest presented period enter that period’s opening balance.
claims.boundary: Materiality and the presented periods are stipulated; supplementary schedules excluded.

claims.claim: A repayable interfund loan creates a receivable for one fund and a payable for the other, rather than a financing-source/use flow.
claims.boundary: Repayment requirement and realistic collection expectation are explicit facts.

claims.claim: A nonrepayable transfer is distinct from a loan; governmental funds separate transfer flows from revenue and expenditure.
claims.exact_locator: Nonreciprocal Interfund Activity; Fund-Level Reporting > In Governmental Funds
claims.boundary: Exclude contested proprietary-fund subsidy presentation.

claims.claim: Reimbursement moves the expenditure to the responsible fund and reduces it in the fund that initially paid.
claims.boundary: Different from charging for services at an exchange price.

claims.claim: Amounts no longer expected to be repaid within a reasonable time require reassessing the loan balance and transfer classification.
claims.boundary: No unsupported legal forgiveness or automatic aging cutoff.

claims.claim: A plan’s employer-contribution measure, allocated net pension liability and pension expense represent different accounting quantities.
claims.exact_locator: Employer’s Contribution; Net Pension Liability (NPL); Pension Expense
claims.boundary: NYSLRS definitions are local implementation context, not a universal formula.

claims.claim: A measurement date identifies when a pension amount was measured and need not be the employer’s statement date.
claims.boundary: Article must label both dates and supplied plan-type assumptions.

claims.claim: Connecticut’s fiscal 2025 note separately presents employer contributions and pension expense, and identifies post-measurement contributions among deferred outflows.
claims.boundary: Historical reporting application; source numbers not copied into a fictional scenario.

claims.claim: That report states post-measurement state contributions reduce the reported net pension liability in the following year; other pension deferrals have expense-recognition schedules.
claims.boundary: Distinguish subsequent-contribution deferrals from other deferred-resource categories.

claims.claim: The selected reporting instructions use amortized cost net of allowance for HTM holdings and fair value for AFS holdings.
claims.boundary: Government/regulator application guidance only; preserve article-specific assumptions and scope limits. No complete current publisher-standard review.

claims.claim: OCC separates AFS credit-loss expense from noncredit loss in accumulated OCI; intended sale or a more-likely-than-not forced sale changes the analysis.
claims.boundary: Government/regulator application guidance only; preserve article-specific assumptions and scope limits. No complete current publisher-standard review.

claims.claim: OCC treats a purchased-security premium or discount as a yield adjustment using the interest method, with separate call and prepayment exceptions.
claims.boundary: Government/regulator application guidance only; preserve article-specific assumptions and scope limits. No complete current publisher-standard review.

claims.claim: Under the described equity method, the investor recognizes its share of investee earnings or losses and reduces the investment for cash distributions.
claims.boundary: Government/regulator application guidance only; preserve article-specific assumptions and scope limits. No complete current publisher-standard review.

claims.claim: OCC distinguishes debt modification from extinguishment; a present-value difference of at least 10%, discounted at the original effective rate, is one substantially-different indicator.
claims.boundary: Government/regulator application guidance only; preserve article-specific assumptions and scope limits. No complete current publisher-standard review.

claims.claim: For the selected bank grant guidance, received conditional grant amounts remain deferred until the donor-imposed conditions are substantially met.
claims.boundary: Government/regulator application guidance only; preserve article-specific assumptions and scope limits. No complete current publisher-standard review.

claims.claim: SEC staff encourages considering direct-method or additional gross operating cash information and warns that a classification-only error can still matter.
claims.boundary: Government/regulator application guidance only; preserve article-specific assumptions and scope limits. No complete current publisher-standard review.

claims.claim: Staff highlights specific cash-flow classification controls and noncash disclosures beyond reconciliation to other statements.
claims.boundary: Government/regulator application guidance only; preserve article-specific assumptions and scope limits. No complete current publisher-standard review.

notices: These are bounded factual research notes, not official standards or completed articles.
Embedded publisher quotations, source numerical example patterns and unexamined diagrams are excluded.
Conflicting state guidance is excluded from supported teaching premises rather than silently reconciled.
